Welcome to Choo!Choo! 2.0! "Give me a straight and a curve, and I shall connect the world." —Ol' Kazko Two tracks can now share the same tile. Lay a curve on a straight, and you have built a switch. No more rigid crossings: it's up to you to invent your own junctions. When your save loaded, your old switches were rebuilt with these new pieces. Your signals stayed put and work just as before.
